name: python-complexity
description: Two censuses of Python complexity, no project install: per function (ruff C901 cyclomatic + complexipy cognitive, read as a pair) and per call path (hops, pass-through layers, selector parameters) for code where every function scores low but the path is hard to follow. Use when asking which functions to refactor first, whether a function or call path is too complex or over-layered, when triaging a legacy codebase, or when verifying a refactor reduced rather than relocated complexity.
